brief.headline: Push for a 13.6% price cut to match Sayaji Industries — we're overpaying ₹14.26 L per year for the same Dextrose

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match ₹66.48/KG — the price Sayaji Industries gives us for the same Dextrose Anhydrous IP
priceAsk.basis: Sayaji Industries already supplies us identical Dextrose at ₹66.48/KG. The open-market asking price sits in a ₹60–81/kg band with typical deals at ₹66–73/kg, so our target sits right in the market's sweet spot. We're leaving ₹14.26 L on the table each year by not holding Universal to the same price.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no change needed

brief.financialLeverage: Universal Starch Chem Allied publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit or cash position. That means we lean on what we do know: we already buy this exact material cheaper elsewhere, and the open market shows our target price is fair. Our ₹59.65 L annual spend gives us enough volume to insist on parity with Sayaji. Because we can't gauge their financial strength, the plan is to line up a second source in parallel — so if they won't move on price, we have a clear path to shift volume without risk.

evidence.point: We pay Universal ₹75.51/KG for Dextrose but Sayaji charges us only ₹66.48/KG for the same material
This price gap costs us an extra ₹14.26 L every year
Open-market asking prices for Anhydrous Dextrose IP run ₹60–81/kg, with typical deals at ₹66–73/kg — our target sits inside that range
India's export unit value for Dextrose is ₹42.95/kg, well below what we pay
We spend ₹59.65 L per year with Universal — enough volume to expect competitive pricing

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ): listed Indore maize wet-miller making Dextrose Anhydrous in IV-fluid grade — exact form match; confirm IP monograph CoA before switching

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ): listed starch and polyol maker, established dextrose supplier — described as a drop-in alternate to Sayaji

alternates.name: Roquette India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ): Indian arm of global starch major, makes pharma-grade dextrose — premium and very reliable (₹2898.05 Cr revenue)

risks: Universal's finances aren't public, so we can't tell if a hard push might destabilise them — keep the tone firm but not aggressive
If they refuse to move, be ready to shift volume to Sayaji or one of the alternates — run a qualification in parallel so we're not caught without supply
Dextrose Anhydrous IP must meet the Indian Pharmacopoeia monograph — any new source needs a CoA review and stability trial before full switch
Current terms are 30 Days After Receipt (not the worst we have), so don't trade away payment flexibility unless they give a big price cut in return
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We've been comparing notes across our Dextrose suppliers, and we're paying you ₹75.51 per kilo when Sayaji gives us the same material at ₹66.48 — help us understand why there's a 13.6% gap and how we close it.
